picks.title: [단독] AI, 새책도 노리나…교보문고에 들어온 ‘10만권’ 주문
picks.excerpt: 국내 최대 서점인 교보문고에 인공지능(AI) 학습용으로 의심되는 대량 도서 주문이 들어온 것으로 14일 확인됐다. 앞서 AI 기업이 배후에서 주도하는 것으로 의심되는 헌책 대량 매입 시도가 확인된 데 이어 새책 주문 사례도 발견된 것이다.
picks.rationale: Exclusive: a 100,000-copy order for new books, suspected to be for AI training, has reached Kyobo, Korea's largest bookstore. The training-data hunt has moved from used books to new stock.

picks.title: Global creative bodies launch ethical AI charter ‘in the vacuum of government policy’
picks.excerpt: The Society of Authors launched a global, ethical AI charter at the Creators Emergency Summit in London on 13th October, aimed at “defining how generative AI services should be deployed to help protect and support human creators”.
picks.rationale: The Society of Authors and global partners have launched a concrete charter setting how generative AI services should treat creators. It is a new, named standard that publishers and AI vendors will be measured against.

picks.title: AI’s Improved Accuracy Squeezes Translation Industry in Japan
picks.excerpt: The uptake of translation powered by generative AI has led to falling sales at translation companies in Japan.
picks.rationale: Sales data shows Japanese translation firms losing revenue as generative AI translation improves. It puts hard numbers on a displacement the translator debate had so far only argued about.

picks.title: Audiobooks with multiple voices for dialog, using human actors or cloned with ElevenLabs
picks.excerpt: Allan Tépper walks through producing a multi-voice audiobook with distinct voices per character, comparing human voice actors with ElevenLabs voice clones for dialogue.
picks.rationale: A hands-on production walkthrough for multi-voice audiobooks that compares human actors with ElevenLabs clones for dialogue. Unlike the narration op-eds, this is a workflow someone can try tomorrow.

picks.title: "웹툰 주인공과 대화한다"… 레진, AI 캐릭터챗 '티즈' 19일 출시
picks.excerpt: 레진엔터테인먼트가 공식 웹툰 IP 기반 AI 캐릭터챗 서비스 '티즈(Teaz)'를 19일 출시한다. 독자가 웹툰 주인공과 직접 대화할 수 있다.
picks.rationale: Lezhin is launching Teaz on Oct 19, an AI character chat built on its official webtoon IP. It is a new product release, and with Naver already in this space it shows AI chat becoming a standard reader feature on webtoon platforms.

alternates.title: 멘탯, AI 기업용 도서 데이터 검색 서비스 '멘탯 디스커버리' 출시
alternates.excerpt: 도서 라이선싱 플랫폼 멘탯이 AI 기업용 도서 데이터 검색 서비스 '멘탯 디스커버리'를 출시했다.
alternates.rationale: A new product release, but it overlaps thematically with the Kyobo training-data pick and comes from a smaller trade outlet. Nearest published story is the kyosu.net interview with Mentat's CEO (09-30).

alternates.title: 웹툰·웹소설을 AI 애니로…카카오픽코마 '탈웹툰' 승부수
alternates.excerpt: 카카오픽코마가 AI로 제작한 애니메이션을 새로운 성장동력으로 육성한다.
alternates.rationale: Strategy feature (part 6 of a series) rather than a discrete release; kept as backup.

https://www.joongang.co.kr/article/25469.new_action: New concrete event: a 100,000-copy order for NEW books, suspected to be for AI training, was confirmed at Kyobo Bookstore on 10-14. The 10-12 story was the publishers' association probing bulk buying of USED books.
